files.ENGINE.md:
# Fixture engine specification

These toy components have intentionally small documented behavior. Judge their configuration under these semantics, not real programs with similar names.

`panel` and `canvas` read config.toml and load profiles/<profile>.toml. Key strings are logical Unicode characters. The normal table supplies exactly the listed bindings, with no inherited translation layer. Both support two-dimensional movement and insert mode. Insert mode accepts literal text. The ru table maps Russian command input to the given Latin key before normal lookup, including the corresponding uppercase letters; modifier bindings are not supported by these two engines.

`devices` reads config.json. Its key strings are physical codes intercepted independently of the current input source. Ctrl+Super directional navigation must preserve logical HJKL intent. Physical H,Y,N,U produce Colemak h,j,k,l and Russian р,н,т,г. Physical J,K,L produce Colemak n,e,i and Russian о,л,д. Outputs Left,Down,Up,Right are layout-independent. Modifier and Shift flags are preserved. There are no other shortcuts in scope for this component.

`desktop` loads config.kdl and its includes. The native source naming is chezmoi: empty_extra.kdl supplies extra.kdl and can be empty. Key names are logical characters, and duplicate same-scope chords are rejected. It supports only the workspace and overview commands shown.

`shell` uses native Nushell source and alias semantics. Existing explicit alias pairs are in scope; text insertion is literal.

`literate` loads init.el, which loads the Org source. Its normal mode bindings are logical characters, and its language map translates the listed Russian characters before normal binding lookup. No modifiers or plugins are supported in this toy mode. It supports only up/down.

`chooser.sh` is an interactive helper. Normal mode navigation and search-field input are separate contexts; only up/down/home/end and search are supported. case branches select their first matching alternative.
